column1: # Key of the Johann Casimir - Camerarius cipher (lead 2187, BSB Clm 10382), rebuilt by Brice Dudout (Claude Opus 5.5 agents), 4 Nov 2026.
# Licence: CC BY 4.0, Brice Dudout. Letter cipher, German; each letter has three homophones in a block of three consecutive numbers.
# Numbers 86 and up are nulls. Not seen: 1-13 and 56-58. No nomenclator seen on the leaves read (names are spelled).
# Learned from the contemporary interlinear glosses of scan 470 only, extended by blocks, frozen (SHA-256 d8b9e735...), then measured once
# on scans 476-477 (validation.txt): 0.873 of characters vs 0.170 for the best of 200 shuffled keys.
# Two changes made AFTER that measurement, so not covered by it: 71-73 = y (learned as i from the gloss 'bei' = 'bey'; the held-out
# part has freyheit, meyne, heyrath) and 44-46 = p (one word only, 'party', 477.04).
